item.title: Invincible VS variant covers from the comic book artists revealed, only available for one system and certain retailers
item.description: <p>After <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/12/2xko-season-1-time/">2XKO</a>, <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/invincible-vs/">Invincible VS</a> is the next fighting game in line to release this year, and fans can get a little bonus if they want something more connected to the comics.</p> <p>Skybound Games has now revealed a couple of special variant covers for Invincible VS though they'll be limited in where you can get them and for what system.</p>

item.title: 2XKO changes plans from 5 seasons in 2026 to only 3
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/06/2xko-official-console-release-date/">2XKO</a> is now only days away from finally launching in earnest, but it seems as though not everything is set in stone behind the scenes.</p> <p>Riot Games has just released a new update blog, which details some changes being made to their content plans for the first year.</p>

item.title: Raging Demon tier list ranks every iconic Super use from Akuma, Evil Ryu, Dark Sakura, and all characters who've used one
item.description: <p>The Raging Demon (or Shun Goku Satsu) has arguably been the most iconic fighting game Super for over 30 years, but not all of them are created equally.</p> <p>As for which Raging Demons are the best / worst of all time, we now have some rankings that try to break them all down.</p>
